name: Dynamic A - Shut-in pressure build-up (illustrative)
description: High-rate producer (choke 50 %, reservoir 430 bara, compact drainage area). Close PWV-101 and watch PT-101 and PT-001 build up from the flowing pressure toward the shut-in pressure. The build-up is calculated from wellbore storage (live-oil compressibility + tubing elasticity) and radial reservoir diffusion - it is not a programmed ramp. All data ILLUSTRATIVE.
briefing: Start the simulation and note PT-101 (tree) and PT-001 (downhole gauge).
Close PWV-101. The valve finishes travelling in ~32 s; the pressures keep rising for much longer.
Early rise: wellbore storage (the liquid column is compressed by the reservoir afterflow). Late rise: the pressure disturbance diffuses outward through the reservoir.
Compare the evolving PT-101 trend with the dashed steady-state reference (the final shut-in pressure).
